intro.title: Connect Fanart.tv
intro.summary: Adds optional logos, backgrounds, and other artwork for Watch and Listen.

steps.title: Account
steps.description: Sign in to Fanart.tv and open your API keys page.
instructions: Create a Fanart.tv account if needed.

steps.title: Get personal key
steps.description: Tuvima supplies its application project key. You may add your personal client key for your Fanart.tv account.
instructions: Copy your personal client key from Fanart.tv.
The application project key is managed by the Tuvima server and is never shown here.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Tuvima will test the application project key together with your personal client key when supplied.

troubleshooting.title: Fanart.tv credentials are incomplete
troubleshooting.message: The Tuvima application project key must be provisioned on the server. A personal client key must use the format shown by Fanart.tv.
instructions: Ask the server administrator to verify the application-managed project key if this field was not available to edit.

troubleshooting.title: Fanart.tv did not accept the connection
troubleshooting.message: The application project key or personal client key was rejected.
instructions: Copy your personal client key again.
If it still fails, ask the server administrator to verify the application project key.

troubleshooting.title: Fanart.tv rate limit reached
troubleshooting.message: Wait briefly, then test the connection again.

troubleshooting.title: Fanart.tv is temporarily unavailable
troubleshooting.message: Your credentials may be valid. Try again later.

troubleshooting.title: Tuvima could not reach Fanart.tv
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: Movies and TV shows will use other artwork sources and may have fewer logos or backgrounds.
Music will use other artwork sources and may have fewer artist or album images.

credentials.label: Tuvima Fanart.tv Project Key
credentials.format_hint: The Fanart.tv project API key provisioned for this Tuvima server.

credentials.label: Fanart.tv Personal Client Key
credentials.format_hint: The optional personal client key from your Fanart.tv account.
